templates.title: AIOPatcher
templates.name: aiopatcher
templates.description: Self-hosted patch and vulnerability dashboard for Linux and Windows servers (agents via mTLS, auto-patch, CVE matching). Dashboard on port 9443, agents on 8443.
templates.note: After deploying: container aiopatcher → Logs → look for the line with Setup token, then open https://<hostname>:9443. Port 8443 (agents) may be public, 9443 internal/VPN only.

env.name: AIOPATCHER_HOSTNAME
env.label: Hostname or IP
env.description: DNS name or IP under which the agents reach this server (e.g. patch.example.com)

env.name: AIOPATCHER_VERSION
env.label: Version
env.description: latest = always the newest version on deploy; or pinned, e.g. 0.6.1

env.name: AIOPATCHER_DATA_PATH
env.label: Data
env.description: Docker volume (name) or folder on the host, e.g. /opt/aiopatcher/data
